MINUTES
  BALDWIN PARK CITY COUNCIL STUDY SESSION
  AND SPECIAL MEETING
  APRIL 15, 2015, 5: 30 P. M.
  COUNCIL CHAMBER - 14403 E. Pacific Avenue, Baldwin Park, 91706

CALL TO ORDER

The meeting was called to order at 5:40 p. m. by Mayor Lozano.
ROLL CALL

PRESENT:
Councilmember Susan Rubio
Mayor Pro Tern Cruz Baca
Mayor Manuel Lozano
Councilmember Monica Garcia ( arrived 5: 59 p.m.)

ABSENT:
Councilmember Ricardo Pacheco

PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS

Mayor Lozano opened Public Communications at 5:40 p. m.

Greg Tuttle, Baldwin Park business owner, inquired about the submission of Mayor Lozano' s
Form 460; commented on the absence of Councilmember Pacheco; voiced his disapproval of
the continued discussion regarding the R- 1 2nd Dwelling Unit Development Standards, alleging
that it was being done as a favor to one individual and that it would only cause problems in the
long run; expressed dissent to the continued use by the soccer league of City playing fields;
opined that the City is violating its own policies and is showing partiality to the soccer league.

John Rios, Baldwin Park resident, opined that Council seems to discuss the same issues over
and over without getting any results or taking any action; stated that the City needs to get
through labor negotiations so they can get on with other business.

Amazon Toreno, Baldwin Park resident, spoke in favor of revising the 2nd Dwelling Unit
Development Standards; stated that her property sits on a 24, 000 square foot lot and that she
wishes to build a second unit on the property for her family; opined that 1, 000 square foot house
is too small.

Seeing no others wishing to speak, Public Communications closed at 5:54 p.m.

OPEN SESSION

RESTORING PREVIOUS CITY EVENTS - Recreation and Community Services
  Recreation and Community Services Director Manuel Carrillo narrated a PowerPoint
  presentation and provided Council with the three City sponsored events that could be
  brought back or continued, outlining the cost and funding source for each.

  Page 1 of 3
   Council discussed each of the items presented and possible alterations to scheduling;
  inquired about timelines for making decisions (since the July 4th Celebration would need to
  be acted upon soon); noted that the item is on this evening' s Regular Agenda and that staff
  would be provided direction at that time.

R-1 2nd DWELLING UNIT DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS - Community Development

  City Planner Amy Harbin narrated a staff report and explained how certain decisions would
  have an impact on the City meeting certain regulations that relate to State.

  Discussion ensued pertaining to how an amendment to the Standards would be applicable
  to properties city-wide and that it may create more issues than it would resolve; discussed
  what current Code allows and possible options for revising the Code without jeopardizing
  the City' s State-approved Housing Element.

  At the conclusion of discussion, Council directed Staff to draft the necessary revisions to the
  development standards for Council' s consideration and bring the matter back in 30 days.

  Professional and Technical Employees Association; Clerical Employees Association;

  Association

the meeting at 6: 58 p. m.
